__IMTTARGET__.content:
Yesterday, an article I’d written with the Telegraph was published. It was about why companies need HR. It was opinion. The comments from readers were absolutely mind blowing. 


Nasty. Personal. Deeply unkind. Very unnecessary. Occasionally supportive. 

And also really rude about my cat, and implying that a cat on my desk (of my home office…) meant something about me. I actually don’t know what it apparently means, other than I like cats and I work from home. 

But I’ve also had comments like these on LinkedIn posts and comments too. 

I don’t post any opinionated comments on other people’s posts now because it turns into people using the 😂 as their comment or reaction in response or a nasty comment. 

It’s got me thinking. 

None of the comments would have been made to my face. 

So why is it ok to say it to me (or anyone) from behind a keyboard?

Why do we tolerate this sort of behaviour online? 

And why would anyone find it acceptable to do this to someone that they don’t even know? 

Anyway. I’m genuinely worried that society is collapsing again and that the end of humankind will be coming soon, and we’ll be replaced by AI! 

At least those commenters will have their wish and be free from evil HR 😂 

For the record, I’m ok with people writing what they did. Has no reflection on me, only on them!

Although I am still smarting a bit from being called “woke” and a “far-left extremist” 😅

My personal Facebook account got hacked, then suspended, the hacker appealed the suspension and then Meta deleted the account. Just like that.


There is no way for me to appeal this (because it has already been appealed by the hacker!) and there is no way for me to speak to a human (because you need to be logged in to do that!). 

I'd also like to add that 2FA was enabled, as were passkeys. Really scary that someone can bypass this (although FB do allow you to skip passkeys and use 2FA via email which defeats the whole point of passkeys?). 

Anyone know of a human being that works at Meta? 

I don't actually care, I only used it to binge watch reels of people cleaning really dirty floors but it's not the point!
